request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Rimefang Wolf".

Creative brief
Name: Rimefang Wolf
Collection: Frostveil Pack. Cold-climate animals adapted to blizzards, frozen lakes, icicles, and delayed shattering projectile patterns.
Core concept: A pack hunter that creates delayed ice bursts from its bite projectiles.
Body and silhouette: Lean wolf with raised shoulders, pointed ears, thick tail, and an ice-covered jaw.
Signature features: Long crystal fangs, frosted back stripe, and pale breath cloud.
Palette and materials: Blue-gray, snow white, pale cyan, and dark navy.
Movement personality: Focused, circling, and suddenly aggressive.
Attack concept: Spits a slow ice fang that stops after a short distance and shatters sideways into two smaller shards.
Directional details: The left ear has a triangular frost-coated tear.
Avoid: Ordinary white wolf, glowing fantasy fire, realistic fur rendering.
